avis.texte: This was my first time trying an eye patch product. It does not get rid of under eye darkness but definitely lightens the area. They only need to be on for 5 -7 minutes and sitting down with your head slightly up helps as they do slide gradually if you do anything while they're on.

Unfortunatly, I had to return it. I bought the 30 pair eye patches based on the ingredient's list which I found very promising and effective. To my surprise the list of ingredients on the actual box was different! Upon further "investigation", I found out that the placement of active ingredients for boxes of 1 and 5 pairs is very (!) different than for 15/30 pair options. I was dismayed by this fact - it's like brand is luring you with the more promising and active staff in the "try out" option of 1/5 pairs patches.
I would say these arent miracle workers but they help a bit. I will save them for times I want to try to look my best. I saw a small change but its definitely not a holy grail product.
